meta.source: AND SO 8.3, the hypermetapunk look (_src/and-so/src/f-draw.js, f2-terrain.js, l-reel.js), measured Nov 2026

tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: The outer ground: page edges, the space past the lattice, slide backgrounds.

tokens.name: aubergine
tokens.usage: The main surface where things are read and played.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: panels, cards, the readout bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and lattice edges only; decorative, never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and names on void, aubergine and plum (13:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, readouts and captions on any ground (7:1 or better); also control borders.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Glow: the live signal. The sounding curve, the active node, the one thing happening now. Axis colour for Tuning.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Axis colour for Shimmer; links in running text.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Axis colour for Pace; a voice at rest; the primary action’s fill, with void text on it.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Axis colour for Space.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Axis colour for Warmth; a held dissonance; errors, always with a word.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Warm highlight on the creature and on large display numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside readouts and chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; the lattice dot pitch.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between panels and sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Around the lattice; outer margins on large screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Readouts and chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels and cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tabs, toggles and nodes.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Only on something live: the sounding node, the active tab. Never on static text.
